entities.summary: Anyu Angelov is Bulgaria's Minister of Defense. Born in Haskovo on December 22, 1942. He graduated from the National Military Artillery School "Georgi Dimitrov" with a degree in radio electronics engineer. He then studied at the Military Academy "Rakovska" under the program of operational and strategic direction of the armed forces. He specialized in the Military Academy of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the USSR in Moscow. Began his military career as a platoon leader. Later he became Chief of Staff, Commander of the Brigade.
